name: Candlelight: Coldplay vs Imagine Dragons
description: Experience the anthems of two of the world's biggest bands in a new light, performed by classical musicians in a venue bathed in candlelight.
longDescription:
Candlelight: Coldplay vs Imagine Dragons offers a classical tribute to two contemporary rock giants. This music event presents the popular songs of Coldplay and Imagine Dragons, reinterpreted by classical musicians. The series is known for its unique atmospheric setting, providing a different perspective on well-known musical works.

Attendees will find themselves in a venue illuminated by numerous candles, creating an intimate and immersive atmosphere for the performance. The program focuses on the melodies and arrangements of the selected bands, performed instrumentally. The duration of the concert is typically around 60-75 minutes. The audience generally consists of music enthusiasts interested in classical interpretations of modern music. The specific venue in Porto for this 2026 event is yet to be announced.

Tickets for this event start from €15. The exact location will be confirmed closer to the date, which will then allow for specific public transport guidance. Information regarding accessibility will also be available once the venue is finalized.
